loadFailed: Could not load. Try again in a moment.

register.notEditable: This request cannot be edited and resubmitted. Only the drafter of a rejected or withdrawn sending approval can edit it.
register.descRequest: Request work from another department or your own. Receiving departments start from receipt.
register.descRegister: Register work for your department. When approval is done it skips receipt and becomes Received. If another department asked for it, choose the requesting department.
register.typeHelp: Choose one or more work types for each receiving department. Types made by that department and the departments above and below it are grouped by the department that made them. "Other" can be chosen together with other types.
register.typeHelpRegister: Choose one or more types made by your department or the departments above and below it.
register.typeKept: originally chosen type (hidden by a closer type with the same name, but kept as is)
register.typeInactive: deactivated. Remove it and choose another type
register.removeTargetConfirm: The work types chosen for {name} will be removed too. Remove it?
register.assigneesHelp: Choose 1–20 active personnel from anywhere in the system in the org chart (expand a department and press a person). They see this request in the Shared with me tab once it is sent.
register.targetsHelp: Expand the org chart and press Add on a department. You can choose your own department and departments of other battalions.
register.targetsNoReceiver: Departments with no one to receive (no member with an account) have no Add button.
register.targetsFixed: For task registration the receiving department is your department.
register.noDepartment: You have no department, so you cannot register work.
register.originsHelp: Choose the departments that asked you for this work (by phone, in person, etc.). They are recorded, notified, and see it under Requested tasks.
register.originsEmpty: If none is chosen, it is registered as your department's own work.
register.viewersHelp: Choose departments or people who can also see this request (required). Expanding a department shows its members; you can also search by name. You can change this later.
register.needFields: Set receiving departments, type, title, place, reason, persons in charge, start date and viewers.
register.needFieldsRegister: Set type, title, place, reason, persons in charge, start date and viewers.
register.staleItems: Some items (work types, departments, people) are deactivated. Remove or choose them again before submitting.
register.uploading: Attachments are still uploading. Submit after they finish.

steps.title: Approval route
steps.help: People you press in the org chart stack below in order. The last person approves, the others review. Approve, full authority, proxy full authority and proxy go last only; vacant goes in the middle only (passed automatically).
steps.selfOnly: With only yourself, it is approved by you right away (set the kind to an approval kind).
steps.noRoute: No default route. Choose from the org chart.
steps.missing: {positions}: no single person found for the position, so it was left out. Choose from the org chart.
steps.duplicate: {name} is already in the approval route.
steps.inactiveAccountNotice: {name}'s account is deactivated, so they cannot be an approver.
steps.inactive: The route has deactivated accounts: {names}. Remove them and choose others.

plan.title: Plan
plan.autoCompleteCheck: Auto-complete when the work period ends
plan.notInRoster: not in roster (deactivated or moved); uncheck to remove
plan.equipmentNotInRoster: not selectable now (disposed, carried out by a person, or moved to another department)
plan.includeHelp: When approval is done, the plan is confirmed together with the receipt.
plan.needDates: Enter start and end dates. The end date must be on or after the start date.
plan.supportHelp: Add plan slots and set a period and personnel/equipment of our department and its sub-departments for each; they become the plan when the approval is finished.
plan.slotOverlapError: Slot {others} overlaps this slot and has the same equipment.
plan.slotPeriodError: This slot must end after it starts.
plan.overallPeriodError: Keep the first slot start to the last slot end within one year.

filter.title: Detailed filters

presets.label: Fill the period back from today

filter.quickTextHint: Title, place, reason, form answers (press Enter)

periodError.missing: Choose both a start date and an end date.
periodError.reversed: The end date must be on or after the start date.
periodError.tooLong: Choose a period of one year or less.

filter.priorityRequest: Priority (urgent if any job is urgent)
filter.attachedOnly: With attachments only (including form file answers)
filter.ownItemNote: Our department tasks are filtered only by that job's work types, form answers, and attachments.

receipts.title: Task Receipt
receipts.desc: Requests sent to your department. Receive now, receive through approval, reject, or transfer to another department.

done.receiveApproval: Submitted receipt approval for '{title}'. It is received when the approval is done.

item.title: Task
item.notFound: Task not found. It does not exist or you cannot view it.
item.readOnly: Only members of the receiving department can handle this task.
item.approvalInProgress: An approval is in progress. Handle it after the approval is done.

dialogs.receiveConfirm: Receive '{title}' now, as the final approver.
dialogs.transferHelp: The receiving department starts again from receipt.
dialogs.transferNoReceiver: Departments with no one to receive (no member with an account) are not listed.
dialogs.planHelp: Set the period, personnel and equipment for each plan slot and confirm at once. Equipment becomes reserved or carried out according to each slot's period.
dialogs.editPlanHelp: Changes the plan at once without approval (members of the receiving department). Work in completion approval or completed work cannot be changed.
dialogs.priorityHelp: Members of the receiving department can change it any time before it ends. Urgent items appear at the top of lists.
dialogs.completeApprovalHelp: The work is completed when this approval is finished. The plan is locked while it is in approval; if it is rejected or withdrawn, the work returns to the plan stage and auto-complete is turned off. If you are the only approver, it is completed at once.
dialogs.autoCompleteHelp: When on, the work is completed by the self-approval of the person who turned it on when the work period (the last plan slot) ends. Saving with it on makes you that person.

requestDetail.title: Request
requestDetail.notFound: Request not found. It does not exist or you cannot view it.
requestDetail.cancelConfirm: Cancel the unsent request '{title}'. Any send approval in progress is also cancelled.

note.title: Instructions
note.help: Notes from people in the receipt approval route (for registered work, the registration route). They cannot be edited or deleted, and the handling department is notified.
note.label: Write instructions

approvals.title: Approve Tasks

tabDesc.myTurn: Approvals waiting for you, and your rejected or withdrawn approvals waiting to be edited and resubmitted or cancelled.
tabDesc.handled: Documents you reviewed or approved, and your own documents that are finished (done, cancelled, or rejected or withdrawn and no longer waiting for resubmission).

approvals.inProgressDesc: Only approvals in progress: ones you submitted, ones you reviewed or approved that are not finished, and ones for your department's work. You can change approvers or withdraw them. Edit and resubmit your rejected or withdrawn approvals from Approve Tasks ▸ My turn.

doc.title: Approval document
doc.subject: Subject task
doc.notFound: Approval document not found. It does not exist or you cannot view it.
doc.autoSubmitted: Submitted by the system for auto-complete (self-approval of the person who turned it on).
doc.resubmitHelp: Submitted as a new round. Earlier rounds are kept.
doc.resubmitCompleteHelp: Resubmits with the current plan. To change the plan, edit it on the work item first.
doc.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this approval in progress. The subject goes back to its state before approval, and you can fix the route and resubmit. If a department member other than the drafter withdraws it, that member becomes the drafter (receiver).

settings.calendarDesc: Choose whether plans in approval show as dashed lines on the calendar. Saved in this browser.

admin.workTypesDesc: Work types received by the target department of your role. Types already used are deactivated instead of deleted. "Other" always stays last and cannot be changed.
admin.noWorkTypeDepartment: There is no department whose work types you can edit.
admin.routesDesc: Default approval routes by department and approval type. A department without a route uses its parent's route. Steps for positions below the base department are left out.
admin.routeEmptyHelp: Removing all steps and saving deletes this department's route so it follows the parent's route.
admin.inherited: No route for this department (follows the parent's route)

errors.default: Could not complete. Try again in a moment.
errors.DATA_CONFLICT: Conflicted with another request. Reload and try again.
errors.REQUEST_INVALID: The input format is not valid.
errors.ASSIGNEES_INVALID: Choose 1–20 active personnel as persons in charge.
errors.CONTACT_INVALID: Enter a contact of up to 30 characters.
errors.TARGETS_INVALID: Choose 1–20 active unit departments without duplicates.
errors.TARGET_NO_RECEIVER: A chosen department has no one to receive (no member with an account).
errors.WORK_TYPE_INVALID: Some work types cannot be chosen. Choose active types again.
errors.WORK_TYPES_REQUIRED: Choose at least one work type for each receiving department.
errors.VIEWERS_INVALID: A viewer department or person could not be found.
errors.REQUEST_STATE: Not possible in the current state.
errors.WORK_STATE: Not possible in the current state. Reload the page.
errors.WORK_CONFLICT: Someone handled it first. Reload and try again.
errors.DOC_CONFLICT: Someone handled it first. Reload and try again.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: A task whose receipt approval was rejected must be received through approval.
errors.APPROVAL_IN_PROGRESS: This task has an approval in progress.
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a rejection reason of up to 500 characters.
errors.TRANSFER_INVALID: Transfer to another active unit department.
errors.TRANSFER_DUPLICATE: That department already has an open task for this request.
errors.PLAN_PERIOD_INVALID: The work period is invalid (each slot must end after it starts; first to last slot within one year).
errors.PLAN_EQUIPMENT_OVERLAP: The same equipment cannot be in two overlapping plan slots.
errors.AUTO_COMPLETE_INVALID: Check the auto-complete condition (a set time must be after now and after the work starts).
errors.PLAN_DUPLICATE: The same person or equipment cannot be chosen twice.
errors.PLAN_PERSONNEL_INVALID: Personnel outside the handling department's roster cannot be chosen.
errors.PLAN_EQUIPMENT_INVALID: Equipment outside the handling department's roster cannot be chosen.
errors.EQUIPMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Some equipment cannot be assigned now (broken, maintenance, disposal pending or out).
errors.EQUIPMENT_BOOKED: Some equipment is used by another task at the same time.
errors.STEPS_REQUIRED: Add at least one person to the approval route (only yourself means it is processed right away).
errors.STEPS_INVALID: The approval route breaks the rules (yourself first, approval kinds last only, vacant in the middle only, each person once, up to 10 steps; changing an approver cannot add yourself or someone already in the route).
errors.APPROVER_INVALID: Only active accounts can be approvers.
errors.STEP_DONE: A handled step cannot be changed.
errors.DOC_NOT_REJECTED: Only rejected or withdrawn approvals can be resubmitted.
errors.DOC_TYPE_INVALID: This approval cannot be resubmitted here.
errors.DOC_TYPE_RETIRED: This approval type has been retired and cannot be resubmitted.
errors.POSITION_INVALID: The position must be section leader, company commander or battalion commander.
errors.WORK_TYPE_DUPLICATE: This department already has a work type with the same name.
errors.WORK_TYPE_CONFLICT: Another administrator changed it first. Reload and try again.
errors.REQUEST_KIND_INVALID: Must be a task request or a task registration.
errors.FILTER_INVALID: The filter conditions are not valid.
errors.ORIGINS_INVALID: A requesting department could not be found (up to 20).
errors.NO_DEPARTMENT: You have no department, so you cannot register work.
errors.WORK_DATE_INVALID: The work schedule is not valid (end date on or after start date, end after start, up to 1 year).
errors.WEEKDAYS_EMPTY: With weekdays only, the period has no weekday.
errors.PRIORITY_INVALID: Priority must be normal or urgent.
errors.PRIORITY_NOT_ALLOWED: Work requests do not set a priority. The receiving department sets it when receiving.
errors.FILE_NOT_TEMP: Some attachments have expired or cannot be used. Remove them and upload again.
errors.FORM_CHANGED: The form changed while you were writing. The new form was loaded; check it and submit again.
errors.PREFERRED_SCHEDULE_INVALID: Check the date and time of day for both choices. Duplicate preferences are not allowed.
errors.DEPARTMENT_SERVICE_CONFLICT: Another member saved changes first. Reload the latest information.
errors.DEPARTMENT_SERVICE_INVALID: Use up to 2,000 characters per field and select your department’s work types.
errors.REQUEST_SCHEDULE_REQUIRED: Enter the preferred date and both times for this scheduled service.
errors.REQUEST_SCHEDULE_INVALID: The preferred end must follow the start, within one year.

applicant.title: Applicant
applicant.name: Rank and name
applicant.contactPlaceholder: Your personnel record has no contact. If entered, it is kept on this request only (optional).
applicant.sentAtHelp: Set to the day the request is sent after approval.

schedule.title: Work schedule
schedule.help: If the end date is empty, the work is one day. With a start time, equipment is carried out at that time; with an end time, auto-complete happens at that time of the last-ending slot.
schedule.requestHelp: This is the requested schedule. When the receiving department receives it, it becomes the task's schedule and shows on the calendar; they can change it when planning.
schedule.registerHelp: This is the work date. When you add a support plan slot, the first slot starts with this period.

headings: When would you prefer the work?
descriptions: Describe your issue for department recommendations, or choose a leaf department directly.
Choose the department’s work type and complete its form, including location and details.
Choose your preferred dates and attach files. The request goes to the whole department.
Review your details, preferred dates and visibility before sending.
flow.help: Use the selected departments’ guidance and forms. Your entries are kept when you move between steps.
flow.footer: Your request is sent after the final review.
errors: Check the receiving departments and their work types.
Complete the required details and department forms.
Check the date and time of day for both choices. Duplicate preferences are not allowed.
Check who can view this request.
flow.contactLater: You can add a contact number in the preferred dates step.
flow.noForm: This work type has no additional form. Enter the request details below.
flow.selfNotice: This request will be sent immediately with self approval. Receiving departments start with receipt.
flow.approvalNotice: The request will be sent to the selected departments after approval.

recommend.issue: Which system needs help, and what is the issue?
recommend.placeholder: For example: I cannot connect to the tactical network.
recommend.basis: Up to three leaf departments are recommended from their registered services, systems, symptoms and search terms.
recommend.changed: Your description changed. Search again to update the recommendations.
recommend.empty: No department matched. Use the expanded organization chart below to choose a leaf department.
recommend.guideFailed: Could not load guidance. Check the form after selecting the department.
recommend.noGuide: No separate guidance is registered. Check the responsibilities before selecting.
recommend.matched: Your description includes this department’s registered work type: {names}.
recommend.manual: Choose a department from the organization chart
recommend.manualHelp: Expand the organization tree. Only leaf departments with available receiving staff can be added.
recommend.profileMatched: Your description matches these registered terms: {names}.

intake.typeHelp: Choose the selected leaf department’s work type before completing its form in the next step.
intake.scheduleHelp: The first choice is required; the second is optional. Choose a date and AM/PM. The receiving department confirms the actual schedule.
intake.departmentDelivery: Send to the selected department without assigning an individual.
intake.scheduleNotice: These are preferences, not a confirmed work schedule.
intake.sendNotice: Sending places this request in the selected department’s receipt queue.

service.title: Department services
service.help: Department members maintain the information used for department recommendations and request guidance.
service.visibility: All users can see this information when finding a department. Describe the scope and the terms people may search for.
service.systemsExample: e.g. video conferencing, meeting room audio
service.responsibilitiesExample: e.g. meeting room audio/video checks and conference connections
service.symptomsExample:
e.g. no video, no sound, cannot connect
Separate terms with commas or new lines.
service.scheduleHelp: Require an exact date and both times for scheduled services such as conferences or interpreting. Leave fault reports optional to show a collapsed schedule field.
service.exact: Required · exact date and start/end times
service.noTypes: No work types are registered. Ask a department administrator to add them.
service.saved: Saved. Recommendations and new requests will use this information.
service.manageLink: Register or edit my department’s service information

guidance.exactHelp: Enter the date and both times. Leave the end date empty for the same day.
guidance.requiredHelp: The selected work type is a scheduled service. Provide the exact date and time.
guidance.optionalHelp: Fault reports can be sent without preferred dates. Enter them only when needed.
guidance.noSchedule: No preferred dates · coordinate with the department
guidance.approvalHelp: If selected, the request is sent after the approval route completes. Otherwise it goes directly to the department’s receipt list.

headings: Which department and service do you need?
descriptions: Find a recommended department or choose one from the organization chart, then select a work type.
Complete the department form, add any required schedule and attach files. The request goes to the selected department.
Review the request and visibility. Choose send approval if needed.
errors: Select a department and one of its work types.
Check the department form, request details and required schedule.
Check visibility and any selected approval route.
